sloka: निकुम्भस्तु रणे नीलं नीलाञ्जनचयप्रभम् ।निर्बिभेद शरैस्तीक्ष्णैः करैर्मेघमिवांशुमान् ।। ६.४३.२९ ।।।।
transliteration: nikumbhastu raṇe nīlaṁ nīlāñjanacayaprabham ।nirbibheda śaraistīkṣṇaiḥ karairmeghamivāṁśumān ।। 6.43.29 ।।।।

translations.english: Nikumbha, the night ranger who was endowed with speed in shooting arrows again shot with a thousand arrows and laughed heartily.
